test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Statement I and Statement II are given below. These statements may be independent causes, effects of independent causes, or common causes. One statement may be an effect of the other. Read both statements carefully and choose the correct answer.

Statement:

The traffic police have issued a traffic advisory regarding traffic diversions for the next two days due to the closure of Raj Bhavan Road.

The Municipal Corporation plans to repair potholes on Raj Bhavan Road tomorrow.

options.text: II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
Both I and II are independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Statement I:

“The traffic police have issued a traffic advisory regarding traffic diversions for the next two days due to the closure of Raj Bhavan Road.”

→ This is an effect. The reason for issuing an advisory is closure of the road.

Statement II:

“The Municipal Corporation plans to repair potholes on Raj Bhavan Road tomorrow.”

→ This is the cause. Because repairing potholes requires the road to be closed.

So Statement I is an effect of Statement II.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
